name: Creamy Milk Chocolate Bar | 200mg
description:
The finest velvety milk chocolate bar available with the cleanest, most potent cannabis distillates in the World.

45% Milk Chocolate | Cannabis

Midnight Roots Genetics has been the recipient of
10  HIGH TIMES Cannabis Cups, including 1 World Cup
Third place in the Inaugural Adam Dunn invitational.
 
Midnight Roots has positioned itself as industry standard creators and connoisseurs of luxury cannabis products.
